reason: The measured ldr:ro process registration must remain live until the last independently owning session or domain object closes; borrowed legacy clones cannot own a freed registration.

api.required_hooks: The optional API requires both retain and close. open yields its first owned reference.
api.legacy: runtime_ipc_register and runtime_ipc_new_session preserve the previous API and borrowed clone behavior. Existing adapters are unchanged.
api.trailing_field: IpcSession.retain defaults to NULL for legacy sessions.

ownership.sm_open: The initial retained session gets its one reference from open; no redundant retain.
ownership.normal_clone_and_clone_ex: A new independent session shares state, calls retain, and carries the same retain and close hooks.
ownership.domain_conversion: The transport transfers its owned hooks/reference into domain root object1 and clears both transport hooks; no reference-count change.
ownership.domain_transport_clone: Only IpcDomain.sessions is incremented; no extra state owner or close hook.
ownership.copy_from_domain: The copied standalone session independently retains the target object state and carries its hooks.
ownership.domain_object_close: Releases the object owner once; independently retained copies remain valid.
ownership.last_domain_transport_close: Destroys remaining domain objects, releasing each real object owner once.
ownership.callback_contract: The service callbacks implement synchronized reference counting and free state only on their last close; generic IPC does not call or interpret guest functions.

validation.fixture: Independent tiny native services with real ipc.c CMIF control/data framing and threads.c handle closing; IPC allocations tracked through final free and all runtime handle slots checked empty. No game/SDK code, GPU or assets.
cases: Both non-domain clone close orders and CloneEx
Domain conversion transfers ownership without retain
Both domain transport clone close orders
Independent domains and copied sessions close in mixed order with final destruction exactly once
Missing retained hooks fail before registration

test_compatibility.scope: Six existing fixture-only positional IpcSession initializers in five files changed to designated initializers for the new trailing field and -Wextra -Werror. No adapter behavior or test expectation changed.

remaining: Root review, commit, actual host build and diagnostic boot; this regression does not prove game execution or NRR/NRO loading.
